fixed, what can we generate from a few starting vectors, and how can we keep track of the resulting
object? The answer has two parts. Seed rank measures how many starting vectors are needed. Packet
coordinates describe the components of vectors and the transfers between them.

mar. From there we study generated hulls, presentations by seeds and relations, and the number of
generators required by a module. The generator results include reduction modulo the Jacobson rad-
ical, the semisimple multiplicity formula over division rings, and the formula for a single operator
